Attack range expands, ATK +30%, ASPD +10; attacks all enemies within “Dominion” simultaneously. When a unit on “Dominion” is attacked by a ground enemy, “Dominion” spreads to the 4 tiles adjacent to the damage source and deals Physical damage equal to 40% of ATK (triggers at most 1 time every 0.5 seconds). When the skill ends, resets “Dominion” on the field
